description: This PHP class 'Location' is part of the OrangeHRM HRM system, specifically within the reporting filter fields. It extends a base 'FilterField' class and implements 'ValueXNormalizable', managing location filter parameters, applying query modifications, and retrieving location data for reports.

classes.name: Location
classes.description: Represents a location filter field used in report queries, allowing filtering by location IDs and converting location data into array format for reporting purposes.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Modifies the query builder to filter results based on specified location IDs, with special handling for 'select all' and 'select by country' cases.

methods.name: getLocationIds
methods.description: Returns an array of location IDs parsed from the 'x' parameter, which is a comma-separated string.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Provides the entity alias used in query context, returning ['location'].

methods.name: toArrayXValue
methods.description: Retrieves the first location entity based on current 'x' value, returning its ID and name as an array, or null if not available.
